claim_verdicts.evidence: git show stage-2:docs/team/refund-plan-example.md lines 32-38: '| Tích hợp API hoàn tiền của cổng thanh toán | 4 | 6 | 14 | 7 |', '| Đối soát hoàn tiền với kế toán | 2 | 4 | 12 | 5 |', '| Cộng hai việc | | | | 12 |', '| Buffer: một nửa tổng (P − M) = ((14 − 6) + (12 − 4)) / 2 | | | | 8 |', '| Tổng phần ước lượng ba điểm | | | | 20 |'. Both code blocks diff-identical to lines 32-38 and 45-49 (stage-2^{commit} 7a131bc).

Lines 45-49 (re-diffed, identical): 'Buffer là một dòng riêng, không chia nhỏ vào từng việc. Nó tính từ khoảng cách giữa bi quan và khả dĩ nhất, nên việc nào càng bất định thì góp vào buffer càng nhiều. Mỗi sprint review, đội ghi đã dùng bao nhiêu ngày buffer. ...' R2: section 5 now says 'a more uncertain item would add more' (conditional), consistent with equal gaps; section 4 'at each sprint review the team writes down how much is used' matches line 47.

Line 58 at stage-2 (wc -l = 58, so it is the last line): 'Buffer đã dùng: 0 / 8 ngày (cập nhật ở mỗi sprint review).' R2 section 5 'The file's last line, not in the blocks above, is the counter' is true: blocks end at lines 38 and 49.

File line 37 states the rule only for this plan ('Buffer: một nửa tổng (P − M)'); it claims no generality. Outline item 3 asks only that 'wider uncertainty gets a bigger buffer'. The lesson names no buffer method (checked: no 'critical chain', no fever chart), matching depth_notes.

R2: section 4 now reads 'the slack hidden in the other tasks rarely reaches it: nobody can see it, and it has usually been used up already'; summary 2 'rarely reaches'; section 6 bullet 2 'tends to get used … rarely reaches'. This is the R1 suggested_text verbatim; hedged ('tends', 'rarely', 'usually') and within outline item 2 ('tends to get used up by that task; one shared buffer stays visible'). No versions.yaml doc governs it; judged against the outline scope contract.

File lines 47-49: 'Buffer chỉ dành cho độ bất định của hai việc trên; việc mới xin thêm không lấy từ buffer mà đưa về product owner để đổi lại kế hoạch.' Lesson wording matches; outline item 4 identical in substance.

Numbers verified: file line 37 computes the buffer from P − M; 14 − 6 = 8, 12 − 4 = 8, each /2 = 4 (python → 4.0 4.0). 'Widest gap adds most' follows from the half-sum rule. But the 'because' is not in the file (lines 37, 45-47 give the rule and 'việc nào càng bất định thì góp vào buffer càng nhiều', no reason), yet section 4 attributes it to the plan ('The plan measures from M … because'). Also 'later than expected' is ambiguous: the item lines are 7 and 5, not M; room past 7 and 5 would be (7 + 7) / 2 = 7, not 8.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: Measuring from M, not O, makes the buffer room for running later than the most likely value; finishing early needs no room. The item with the widest gap adds most; in the refund plan both gaps happen to be 8, so each adds 4 days.

issues.text: Claim 8: the reason for measuring from M is the lesson's own explanation, but is worded as the plan's intent, and 'than expected' can be read as 'than the item line' (7 and 5), for which the M-to-P gap is not the room. R1 major (equal gaps) is fixed; this is what remains.
issues.quote: The plan measures from M, not O, because the buffer is room for running later than expected; finishing early needs no room.
issues.fix: Replace with: 'Measuring from M, not O, makes the buffer room for running later than the most likely value; finishing early needs no room.' Update claim 8 text to match.

issues.text: Unlisted recommendation (conditional, so not opinion-as-fact, and one sentence does not teach fever-chart tracking, which depth_notes exclude). It is not in the file, which only says the plan is reviewed at each sprint planning (line 55-56). Not in any claim.
issues.quote: If the buffer runs down faster than the work moves, that is the moment to talk to the product owner about the plan.
issues.fix: No text change needed. Add to claim 6 (or a new opinion claim): 'If the buffer runs down faster than the work moves, the team raises the plan with the product owner; source: outline item 2 (visible consumption).'

issues.text: Key (c) is still the only correct option, but its reason drifts from the lesson: what nobody sees is the hidden slack, not the need (the late task's need is visible). 'stay where they are' is also the absolute form R1 asked to remove from section 4.
issues.quote: False, because days hidden inside tasks stay where they are, and nobody sees they are needed elsewhere.
issues.fix: Option c en: 'False, because days hidden inside tasks are invisible to everyone else and usually get used up before the late task needs them.' vi: 'Sai, vì ngày giấu trong từng việc không ai khác thấy, và thường bị dùng hết trước khi việc bị trễ cần tới.'

issues.text: Key (a) correct; R1 premise issue fixed (no 'first sprint', integration no longer half-done). But the explanation overstates: with the accounting check barely started and the integration done, the uncertain work left is one of two items (gap 8 of 16, estimate 5 of 12), not 'most'.
issues.quote: Most of the room is gone with most of the uncertain work still ahead, so the plan is likely to move.
issues.fix: en: 'Most of the room is gone with a whole uncertain item still ahead, so the plan is likely to move.' vi: 'Phần lớn chỗ trống đã hết trong khi cả một việc bất định còn ở phía trước, nên kế hoạch nhiều khả năng sẽ dịch.'

issues.text: I understand the sentence and can answer q6 with it, but 'faster than the work moves' made me stop once: the lesson never says how to compare the two. The '3 of 8 days used halfway through' example just before it helps; one concrete contrast would remove the guess.
issues.quote: If the buffer runs down faster than the work moves, that is the moment to talk to the product owner about the plan.
issues.fix: Optionally add a short example after 'moves', e.g. '(most of the buffer gone while most of the work is still ahead)'; otherwise leave as is.
